bluf: Al Jazeera and France 24 reported that two Doctors Without Borders staff were killed in an Israeli strike at a Gaza clinic; MSF said the clinic was marked with its logos and its location was known to the Israeli military. BleepingComputer reported that a Cacti vulnerability was publicly disclosed with a proof-of-concept that enables unauthenticated command execution on vulnerable servers.

cyber.text: BleepingComputer reported that a Cacti zero-day vulnerability was publicly disclosed with a proof-of-concept enabling unauthenticated attackers to execute commands on vulnerable servers.

items.text: France 24 reported that a senior Ukrainian official said Ukraine had offered a Black Sea ceasefire to enable food exports and was awaiting Russia’s response.
France 24 reported that Russian authorities said Russia shot down over 1,200 drones targeting Moscow overnight.

Al Jazeera and France 24 reported that an Israeli strike killed two Doctors Without Borders staff at a clinic in Gaza. France 24 reported that the Israeli army labelled the pair as Hamas “terrorists”; Al Jazeera reported that MSF said the clinic was clearly marked and its location known to the Israeli military.
